title: Listed companies whose annual reports the regulator's filings set lands

name.description: The company's legal name as the legal-entity register records it.

cik.description: The regulator's company id, as its data sets write it: digits, no leading zero.

lei.description: The company's legal-entity identifier, the one vendor matching gives the vendor.

isin.description: The listed share the register's ISIN mapping files under the LEI; its middle nine characters are the CUSIP.

ticker.description: The ticker the regulator's fails-to-deliver files give that CUSIP, and its ticker list maps to the CIK.
